runs.t: A complete prefabricated data center solution.

Structural precast systems and exterior wall panels for mission-critical data centers — integrating early design-assist and in-house manufacturing to support accelerated schedules, sustainability goals, and project predictability.
Adapts to future expansion — engineered for heavy data center floor loads, long spans, and flexible bay planning for current and future high-density compute.
Parallel offsite fabrication compresses the critical path by 30–50% vs. traditional methods. Structure and enclosure manufactured while site work advances.
Reduced rework, fewer field trades, and predictable logistics — translating to tens of millions in savings on a typical 100MW facility.
Factory-controlled production and just-in-time delivery from regional plants ensure components arrive on schedule, every time.
CARBONSHIELD® replaces 25% of the portland cement in our mixes, reducing embodied carbon by roughly 20% — with EPDs available for every project.
Inherent fire resistance (2-hour UL rating), seismic capability, and wind resistance — the structural system that protects critical assets.
Max live load superimposed floor capacity
Long-span capability — fewer interior columns, more open white space
Faster delivery than traditional construction methods
Industrial manufacturing capacity serving the Southwest and Western regions

Offsite construction can deliver projects 30–50% faster than traditional methods. Manufacturing of the structure occurs simultaneously with site and foundation work — schedule delays due to weather and external factors are significantly reduced since the majority of construction takes place in a controlled environment.

AccelCore™ combines structure, enclosure, openings, embeds, and MEP coordination into a prefabricated precast system that can be engineered before components arrive on site — supporting faster erection, earlier dry-in, and fewer field-built interfaces.
Take Advantage of Our Test Fit Services
CARBONSHIELD® is a unique and proprietary concrete mix developed by Clark Pacific that provides the same performance as traditional mixes and is standard in our structural products.
It replaces 25% of the portland cement in our concrete mixes, reducing embodied carbon by roughly 20%. Our goal is double this by 2030, through our continuous R&D efforts and material partnerships.
In critical applications where continuous operation is imperative, the choice of materials is crucial. Data centers require resiliency and durability — precast stands out as the ideal solution.

runs.t: Precast concrete materials that stand the test of time — minimizing lifecycle maintenance costs.

AccelCore™ is Clark Pacific's prefabricated structural solution for data centers and other critical facilities. The system brings together major precast building components — including structure, floor and roof systems, insulated wall panels, openings, embeds, connections, and coordinated equipment interfaces — into a factory-produced kit of parts.
Why choose AccelCore™ instead of a steel or cast-in-place concrete approach?
Can AccelCore™ support multi-story data centers and campus rollouts?
Does AccelCore™ support sustainability and lower embodied carbon goals?
Insulated wall panels engineered to meet desired thermal performance — cladding or load bearing, with 100+ finish options.
Prefabricated elevated chiller support system — accelerates the construction schedule an additional 4–8 weeks.
Prefabricated power buildings and generator enclosures — factory-built electrical infrastructure for data center campus delivery.
Our team works as an extension of yours — early design-assist, in-house manufacturing, and single-source accountability from contract through warranty.
Clark Pacific is a leading manufacturer of prefabricated building systems. We are transforming design and construction by delivering high-quality, cost-effective buildings with less risk.
